 Via University of Houston Athletics, 6h ago AUSTIN — Behind sophomore Samira MInor’s golden goal, the University of Houston Soccer team knocked off (5) Texas, 4-3 in overtime at Mike A. Myers Stadium Friday evening in the First Round of the NCAA Tournament. Minor scored a pair of goals on the evening for her third-career brace and second of the season. Texas (9-6-7) got out to an early lead in the 12th minute when Carolina Swan turned and shot through traffic to get the Longhorns on the board first.
